text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
F-Fuji-senpai... Um, I...
There's something about the dance that I really, really
wanted to consult you about...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
With pleasure, little pony!
I'll never let you regret choosing me.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Hauu...! Fuji-senpai...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I just can't remember the formulas for this section.
I always make the exact same mistakes...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Then listen closely to my voice.
...Shall we try memorizing it with my voice?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Eep, y-yis...! If it's with Fuji-senpai's voice, I'll definitely be able to remember...!

Fuji Kiseki handles everything with finesse.
She never shows hesitation or doubt, so many students rely on her.
Perhaps I ought to learn from her as her Trainer.
choice_data_list: Shall we do some training, Pony-chan...?

text_block_list.text:
...Saying it aloud, I hold my head in my hands.
Seriously, not this. If anything, it'll just make them anxious—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hmm, was she... trying to imitate me just now?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Just a moment ago.
What a wonderful surprise!
It really suited you.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, I know! Trainer-san.
Tomorrow's a day off, so wanna spend it together?
I want to play a little game, just the two of us!"

The next morning. I thought I arrived early,
but Fuji Kiseki was already waiting
at our meeting spot—
choice_data_list: D-Did I keep you waiting, pony-chan?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all. Your face is all red, are you all right?
You must have run over as soon as you saw me.
There's no need to rush, so catch your breath.

—The "game" Fuji Kiseki mentioned
was simply "imitating each other's usual behavior."

Rather than the tone of voice, what matters most is the reaction and attitude,
which makes it a good opportunity to get to know each other, Fuji Kiseki says, but...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Well then, shall we get going?
If you get tired, don't push yourself—just let me know. Got it?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that great!
That's a higher score than before.
Could you show me that one more time?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm watching over you, so just
relax your shoulders and do your best!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"We've been singing for quite a while... isn't your throat dry?
Shall we order something to drink?"
choice_data_list: Y-Your canary-like voice, I want to hear more...
Ah, more of your canary-like voice...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...You want to listen?
All right. But first, let's take a break.
We've got plenty of time, so let's relax and enjoy ourselves."

We've been continuing this 'game' all this time, but
the way Fuji Kiseki imitates me is, well, how should I put it...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Are you tired? We did walk a lot.
Let's call it a day, shall we?"

Praising when praise is due, understanding the other person, and showing thorough consideration.
She almost seems... like a remarkably mature adult.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. How was it?
Today's "game."
Did you have fun?
choice_data_list: Maybe we didn't really look alike after all?

text_block_list.text:
"Whether it was similar or not is open to debate,
but while remembering Fuji Kiseki,
how did she act, and how did she react—"
I tell Fuji Kiseki that thinking about such things makes me feel like I understand her more deeply.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I see, so you were thinking about me all day long, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm glad.
As long as we both had a good time, I'm satisfied.
—And also.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Did you manage to understand...
how Trainer looks through my eyes too?"
Seeing me freeze up in speechless silence, Fuji Kiseki flashed a mischievous grin.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Oh, is that so?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...I see, you might be right.
Because the Trainer I see is even more wonderful than that!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Oh yeah,
about how you saw me, Trainer...
Yeah, it wasn't bad at all.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "Still, next time, I want us to understand each other even more... enough to play each other to perfection, don't you?"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: What should I do for that, I wonder...?

"Fuji Kiseki laughed pleasantly
as she watched me fluster..."
